# 2026-09-29 — Due-Date Slip Clarity

> Status: reviewed. Participants: Jo and Maya. Evidence: two illegible slips, checked against checkout dates.

## Observations

Two slips were hard to read. Both due dates were reconstructed from their checkout dates; no loan term changed. Merely increasing the font size cannot fix unclear spoken handoffs.

## Decisions

Read the written due date aloud at checkout and let the borrower correct an unreadable slip before leaving. This became [D-03](../decisions.md#decision-log).

## Actions

Jo checks this step for three shifts as [A-04](../actions.md#open-actions). Update the reusable [desk procedure](../../handbook/check-in/README.md) only when it does not change local policy.
